videos.title: GPT-6.1 Astra: Why OpenAI Scrapped It
videos.description:

Its predecessor, GPT-6 Astra, scored 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3 with OpenAI's own harness, but 62.7% under ARC Prize's standard harness. OpenAI kept the base model for future GPT-6 work. Reported by WSJ; confirmed on record by OpenAI's head of safety systems. Verified 12 October 2026.
Source: https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/
